# Ali Abdulmalek {.display-name}

[International Relations, Political Science & Data Analysis]{.hero-subtitle}

I am an undergraduate student at Loyola Marymount University studying International Relations, with minors in Political Science and Applied Data Analysis. My academic interests focus on the Middle East and North Africa, particularly the relationship between political institutions, economic development, geopolitics, and economic diversification.

I am especially interested in understanding how states respond to regional and global change, and how quantitative and computational methods can be used to study political and economic questions.

[Explore my research](research.qmd){.primary-link} [Say hello](mailto:aabdulm1@lion.lmu.edu){.quiet-link}

[01 / ACADEMIC INTERESTS]{.eyebrow}

## Questions worth asking

My interests lie at the intersection of international relations, political science, economics, and applied data analysis. I am particularly interested in how political institutions and international forces shape economic development, governance, and change across the Middle East and North Africa.
